Your impact
  
  

A Jacobs Senior Graphic Designer is a proactive team player, excited and ready to engage on a multitude of projects, from concept to completion—from handouts and project sheets to complex visually \- compelling proposals and presentations—in a fast\-paced environment for our Buildings \& Infrastructure Americas team. Must be highly creative and innovative, ready to conceptualize, design, and develop visually appealing graphics and content that will inform and engage the intended audience. This role requires expert technical skills and expertise in developing and executing creative solutions using Adobe Creative Cloud applications (including, but not limited to: InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop), as well as presentation software (including but not limited to: Microsoft PowerPoint) to deliver those solutions in a variety of print and digital formats. Along with excellent communication skills, this individual will be flexible, dedicated, organized, collaborative, self\-motivated, and can work effectively in a fast paced, deadline\-driven environment.
  
  

Applicants must provide either a portfolio link or PDF samples of work that highlight your work in layout, graphics and presentation.
  
  

Prior Architectural/Engineering \& Construction and/or Proposal and Sales experience a plus. Applicants must be prepared to flex their working hours as needed to align with peers in North America. Must have
  
  

flexibility to work overtime hours and on weekends as needed, especially for deadline\-driven assignments.
  
  

Main Duties \& Responsibilities
  
  

Each day will present different activities and opportunities as you help position Jacobs for success in our sales efforts. Our Senior Graphic Designers will be responsible for the following general activities:
  
  

Independently drive strategic graphic design solutions to support the production of winning complex proposals, sales materials, and presentations, including but not limited to long document layouts, PowerPoint presentations, story boards, covers/dividers, marketing collateral/brochures, illustrations, interactive PDFs, ads, and digital media
  
Leads interview visuals and presentations by working live to develop sketches and concepts
  
Understands diverse perspectives and offers ideas to solve design problems and drive effective solutions
  
Plans, conceptualizes, and designs compelling and impactful graphics while collaborating with proposal team members and technical staff to strengthen messaging and successfully sell Jacobs
  
Knowledgeable of one or more markets and/or client groups within Jacobs; begin to develop relationships account teams
  
Conveys complex ideas with smart and concise graphic designs; develops complex concepts visually beyond bullet points
  
Interpret and convert technical data and conceptual content into more accessible and visually appealing information
  
Uses diverse perspectives to solve design problems and drive effective solutions
  
Expert in software trends; acts as a resource for graphic design methods and tools, developing and implementing process improvements, tool(s) improvements, and best practices
  
Shares technical expertise with others and provides guidance and support; mentors junior staff to help grow their skills and advance their careers
  
Coordinate and provide production and vendor support for submittals and interviews to instruct external vendors as needed on printing requirements
  
Provides improvements in processes, productivity, and efficiency for our Creative Solutions team
  
Proof work to ensure quality control
  
Proven experience dealing with constantly evolving deadlines in an ever\-changing landscape; must be able to coordinate and collaborate with team members in remote locations, in different time zones
  
  

Other Job Specifications \& Expectations
  
  

Collaborative and engaging mindset; thrives in a detail\-focused, highly deadline\-driven, team\-oriented environment
  
Displays highest level of creativity, with proactive, and innovative work approaches; implements ideas, solves problems, and creates advanced, complex visual solutions to bring concepts to life
  
Customer service\-oriented demeanor with a positive, collaborative, and energetic approach focused on deepening relationships with account teams
  
Confidence and ability to drive concepts with team members, high level executives and decision makers
  
Problem solver, critical thinking skills with a solution\-oriented approach
  
Must have strong written and verbal communications skills and the ability to work directly with internal clients; ability to edit and proofread a plus
  
Manages multiple, complex project assignments at a time, set priorities, manage time, and organize work according to best practices
  
Flexibility to work extended hours and weekends when project deadlines require
  
Motivation to continually self\-improve with a desire to learn new innovative tools, techniques and processes
  
  

Sales Functions and Processes
  
  

Dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external clients
  
Translates project and client requirements into scope of work
  
Identifies areas in proposals where graphics are better suited to tell a story
  
  

Jacobs/Industry Acumen
  
  

Embraces our organizational core values, code of conduct, and culture of caring, safety and inclusion
  
Compliance with corporate processes, procedures and protocols
  
  

Here's what you'll need
  
  

Associate or bachelor’s degree in graphic design or related discipline from a four\-year College/University; work experience in A/E/C that matches the requirements of the position in lieu of degree;
  
  

Ideally, here’s what you’ll also have
